title: Low-Correlation Volume-Price Factor Mining Strategy Based on GFlowNet
tldr: GFlowNet generates diverse low-correlation alpha factors outperforming RL which suffers mode collapse. Daily factors achieve IC median 6.17%; minute-frequency factors achieve IC median 5.83% with long excess return median 7.43%.
abstract: This report proposes using GFlowNet (Generative Flow Networks) for automated factor mining, generating diverse low-correlation factors by modeling the generation process as flow in a DAG, where the probability of generating an object is proportional to its reward. Compared to RL (PPO) which suffers mode collapse with batch correlation median reaching 1, GFlowNet maintains batch correlation median below 0.04. Using daily volume-price data with two feature sets (raw OHLCV and dimensionless relative features), and minute-frequency data reduced to 40 daily features, the system mines factors with market-cap-neutralized abs(IC) as reward. On daily data, relative-feature factors achieve IC mean median of 6.17%; on minute-frequency data, IC mean median reaches 5.83% with long excess return median of 7.43%. The mined factors also enhance existing GRU+Mamba stock selection models and index enhancement strategies.
strategy: The core strategy leverages GFlowNet to mine a pool of diverse, low-correlation alpha factors from volume-price data. Unlike reinforcement learning which seeks a single optimal solution (arg max R(x)), GFlowNet's objective is to sample objects proportional to their reward: P(x) ∝ R(x), naturally ensuring diversity. [source: "它以'生成一群优秀的多元化公式'为核心目标，核心任务是生成组合型对象...使得生成某个对象x的概率与其对应的奖励成正比"] The strategy involves three data pipelines: (1) raw OHLCV daily data, (2) dimensionless relative features derived from OHLCV, and (3) 40 daily features constructed from intraday minute-frequency data capturing price momentum, volatility, and price-position relationships. The reward is set as market-cap-neutralized abs(IC) to avoid excessive small-cap exposure. [source: "我们将因子的reward设定为市值中性化后的abs(IC)"] Mined factors are equally-weighted by factor direction to form composite factors, which are then integrated into existing GRU+Mamba deep learning stock selection frameworks for index enhancement strategies across CSI 300, CSI 500, and CSI 1000.
method: The GFlowNet factor mining system uses Trajectory Balance (TB) as the training objective for stability, where a learnable scalar Z estimates total flow, and the forward policy PF is learned via sampling trajectories, computing rewards, and backpropagating TB loss. [source: "训练采用更稳定的Trajectory Balance(TB)目标，通过采样轨迹、计算奖励与TB损失并反向传播更新模型参数完成训练"] The state representation combines Transformer encoding of the action history sequence (operator/window/feature) with 3 handcrafted state features (current depth, operator ratio, node ratio). The action space includes 51 operators (unary, time-series unary, binary, time-series binary, cross-sectional), 5 window sizes, and variable features. Expressions are organized as ExprNode trees with simplification rules (commutativity sorting, double-neg folding) to reduce redundancy. [source: "表达式以ExprNode树结构进行组织，同时构建交换律排序、双重neg折叠等简化方法"] Grammar and complexity constraints limit each step to syntactically valid actions. The training set spans 2005-2017, test set 2018-2025, with 10-day rebalancing and full-A market scope. Factor selection requires Spearman correlation below 0.4 with previously selected factors.
experiment: Experiments compare GFlowNet against a PPO-based RL system with identical environment, state space, and network architecture (Transformer Actor-Critic). RL shows faster initial batch reward increase but severe mode collapse: batch correlation median rises to 1, while GFlowNet maintains median below 0.04. [source: "GFlowNet batch内相关性中位数不到0.04，多样性优势显著"] On daily OHLCV data, single factors achieve IC mean median of 4.54% (max 8.56%), long excess return median 3.47%. With relative features, IC mean median improves to 6.17% (max 9.40%). [source: "基于相对特征挖掘的因子表现更优，IC均值中位数达6.17%"] Minute-frequency features yield IC mean median 5.83% (max 9.46%), long excess return median 7.43%. [source: "基于分钟频构造特征挖掘的单因子表现优异，IC均值中位数达5.83%...多头超额收益中位数为7.43%"] For composite factors, minute-frequency features achieve RankIC 12.25%, long excess return 16.08%, long-short Sharpe 5.84. Adding 150 GFlowNet factors to GRU+Mamba improves RankIC from 13.52% to 13.67% and long-short Sharpe from 9.97 to 10.21. Index enhancement strategies achieve annualized excess returns of 9.96% (CSI 300), 11.16% (CSI 500), and 19.12% (CSI 1000).
result: GFlowNet demonstrates significant diversity advantage over RL, with batch correlation median below 0.04 vs. RL's 1.0. [source: "GFlowNet batch内相关性中位数不到0.04"] On daily data, relative-feature factors achieve IC mean median 6.17% and long excess return median 4.75%. [source: "IC均值中位数达6.17%...多头超额表现也更好，中位数为4.75%"] Minute-frequency factors achieve IC mean median 5.83% and long excess return median 7.43%. [source: "IC均值中位数达5.83%...多头超额收益中位数为7.43%"] Composite minute-frequency factors yield RankIC 12.25% and long-short Sharpe ratio 5.84. Integrating 150 GFlowNet factors into GRU+Mamba model improves long excess return from 31.95% to 32.88% and long-short Sharpe from 9.97 to 10.21. [source: "添加GFlowNet挖掘出的150个因子，可以发现几乎所有指标都有一定的提升"] CSI 1000 index enhancement achieves 19.12% annualized excess return with information ratio 2.99.
